narrowing_actions: Contribution 1 now binds the constrained formulation to execution of supported native CE semantics.
Contribution 3 now names statistics-semantic dependencies and statistics-design moves.
Introduction recognizes automatic statistics management, what-if evaluation, INUM, and C-PQO.
Related Work distinguishes represented computation rather than claiming generic specialization/reuse novelty.
Learned CE comparison includes query-driven, data-driven, and factor-graph examples.
PostgreSQL MCV/FD rules are explicitly native semantics, not inventions.
positive_positioning: CE-Replay focuses on the interface between statistics physical design and the supported statistics-sensitive native CE computation, making that computation executable under hypothetical statistics states for both workload-objective evaluation and statistics-semantic dependency exposure.
strongest_novelty_threat: C-PQO and INUM already build reusable representations for evaluating many physical configurations without repeated full optimizer calls.
bounded_distinction: CE-Replay represents the supported statistics-sensitive estimator control/numerical computation and its dependencies, rather than plan/cost response across access-structure configurations.
